name: bionativa-lab-web
description: Sitio web oficial y tienda online de BioNativa LAB

scripts.build:css: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$twDir = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'bionativa-tailwind'; if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $twDir 'node_modules\.bin\tailwindcss.cmd'))) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $twDir | Out-Null; npm --prefix $twDir install --no-save tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli }; $env:NODE_PATH = Join-Path $twDir 'node_modules'; & (Join-Path $twDir 'node_modules\.bin\tailwindcss.cmd') -i ./src/tailwind.css -o ./css/tailwind.min.css --minify"
